Usage: command-code [options] [command]

  -p, --print                 print response and exit (non-interactive)
      --output-format <fmt>   output format for -p: text | json | stream-json
      --permission-mode <m>   plan | dont-ask | yolo
      --skip-onboarding       skip the first-run onboarding flow
      --no-session            do not retain a session transcript
      --no-auto-update        do not check for or apply updates
      --trust                 trust the current working directory
      --no-skills             do not load project or user skills
      --max-turns <n>         maximum agentic turns for this run
  -m, --model <id>            exact model id for this run
